result.summary: The home screen is mostly clean, but there is one clear defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has overlapping text in its metadata line. A smaller issue is a delivery-time pill that overlaps its image.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the metadata line under the title has overlapping text. The delivery time ("25–35 min") collides with the delivery fee ("€0 delivery"), which makes both unreadable and looks like a rendering or duplicated-element bug.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the metadata row so the time, fee and cuisine are separate, non-overlapping items with consistent separators (for example "25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen"). Remove any duplicated or absolutely positioned text.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" cards, the time pill (e.g. "15–25 min") overlaps the plate illustration in the Green Bowl Poké card. The pill also sits inconsistently over the image edge, which looks cramped.
issues.suggestion: Give the pill consistent padding from the card's bottom-left corner, and keep it clear of the key image content.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, the "(500+)" rating count, and the meta line) is light and small against white, so contrast is low.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
